author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Freshly baked buns filled with savory beef and tender potatoes make the perfect comfort food for a cool autumn day 🍂🥔 In this video, we prepare rustic homemade buns from scratch using soft dough and a hearty filling.

Each bun is generously stuffed with seasoned beef and potatoes, then baked until beautifully golden. The outside becomes lightly crisp while the inside stays soft, warm, and full of rich homemade flavor.

These beef and potato buns are simple, filling, and perfect for cozy autumn baking. Handmade dough, a hearty meat filling, and traditional village-style preparation create a comforting meal that’s best enjoyed fresh from the oven with family. 🥩🍞🔥
title: Rustic Beef & Potato Buns | Cozy Autumn Baking 🍂🥔
